program.description: A program: one block of declarations that compiles to an executable.

property.description: A property: typed fields with defaults — a per-entity component, or a record made with `new`.

model.description: An entity kind bundling a fixed set of properties.

prefab.description: A model with preset property fields; `spawn` adds only what differs.

handler.description: A handler that runs once per tick in its phase.

handler with query.description: A handler whose body runs once per matching entity, each property bound by name.

for query.description: Iterate every entity matching a query.

spawn.description: Create an entity of a model or prefab.

scene.description: A scene with lifecycle hooks and one layer of handlers.

ui.description: A retained UI tree, declared as data.

machine.description: A state machine over an enum-typed variable; `become` transitions.

event.description: An event payload; fire it with `emit`, listen with `@On`.

listener.description: A listener on an event, its payload fields bound by name.

namespace.description: A block of functions callable as Name.method(); `internal` keeps a helper private.

extern function.description: Bind a C symbol through the FFI.
